summary: @holocronlab/botruntime-runtime is a rebrand of the Botpress SDK that defaults its API base URL to https://botruntime.ru, routing BP_TOKEN and bot API traffic to an unrelated.ru host
details: This package is a repackaged copy of the legitimate @botpress/* SDK. Source maps reference github.com/botpress/botpress and github.com/botpress/skynet, internal paths mirror Botpress's own client (../src/runtime/client.ts,../src/consts.ts), and JSDoc still describes the exported `client` as 'the authenticated Botpress client'. The runtime constants swap Botpress's documented api.botpress.cloud / api.botpress.dev endpoints for https://botruntime.ru as the default value of ADK_API_URL. Callers who follow the Botpress convention of setting BP_TOKEN (or the aliased ADK_TOKEN, ADK_BOT_ID, ADK_WORKSPACE_ID) and importing `client` end up sending those authentication tokens plus all bot API traffic to botruntime.ru — a.ru host unrelated to the declared publisher (@holocronlab / github.com/HolocronLab/botruntime-packages) and unrelated to Botpress. The rebrand ('botruntime' / 'brt' / HolocronLab) preserves the Botpress env-var names and API shape, so the redirection is not visible to a developer who trusts the Botpress ecosystem.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
